audit.why: The prose addresses the owner in second person, so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy. These templates were authored for a male enemy and only the champion name was substituted, leaving the pronouns wrong. champ-data/champ-gender.js is the authority.

edits.before: Blitz owns levels 1-2 outright: his Rocket Grab out-ranges Renata's Q poke and she has no mobility to dodge it, so she and her ADC must respect grab range and give up lane control. Renata can Loyalty-shield her ADC after a hook connects, but she cannot save herself, so aim the grab at Renata when she steps up to ward. Win the ward war by threatening the hook on anyone who walks into the river brush.

edits.before: In 2-item-plus fights Blitz still opens with the pick, but this is where Renata claws it back: her R Hostile Takeover charms whoever it catches and her W can revive a fallen carry, so even a clean Blitz hook can be answered by a team-turning ult. If Blitz whiffs Q his 8-13s cooldown leaves him useless while Renata's disengage and berserk swing the fight, which is why the final full-build stage tips to Renata.
